items.text: A good emcee script for a career guidance programme keeps the event on time, introduces speakers clearly, links each session to what students need and closes with thanks and next steps, and a short, warm invitation helps students and parents know the purpose, date, place and what to bring.
Confirm speaker names, titles, timings and any permissions with the school or college before printing or announcing.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
